name: Orbs
soft_passes: #3 silhouette reads as a plain dot when filled solid — identity is tonal (gloss ramp), not silhouette-borne; on-subject but leans on lighting
failures: #10 variant robustness — figure wholly dependent on opaque black field; baked specular + no glass layers means no proper Liquid Glass Default/Dark/Clear/Tinted variants; reads as legacy pre-Tahoe icon
light_model: single top-down source; broad baked specular cap blown to #FDFDFD across the top third of the metallic annulus, flaring slightly over the inner boundary; convex glossy silver ring darkening to mid-grey (#7E) at the sides with a slight ambient lift (#8C) at the bottom; recessed inner well top-lit (#1F) to darkest-at-bottom (#0F). Baked (not system-applied) specular = legacy authoring.
layer_stack: brushed-silver annulus with vertical gloss ramp #FDFDFD->#7E7E7E + baked top specular cap
recessed near-black inner disc, top-lit #1F1F1E -> dark #0F0F10
devices: glossy monochrome orb (Aqua/chrome-sphere quotation inside a Big Sur squircle)
concentric-ring composition that literally diagrams the radial launcher subject
rhymes_hint: glossy monochrome hardware-dot family: camera/PhotoBooth aperture icons, webcam/record-button orbs, Aqua-era glossy button spheres, volume/knob hardware icons; distinct from the Big Sur diagonal-tool-on-coloured-gradient mainstream (no tool overlay, no hue)
notes: 512x512 web render (half the 1024 master); PNG carries a baked drop-shadow on a white plate = an exported composite, not the delivered unmasked square layer, so true mask edge and system-vs-baked shadow are unverifiable. Palette hexes are clean (measured) from the render. Big Sur structural grammar (uniform squircle, front-facing, top-down baked light, single abstract glyph) but material is an Aqua/skeuomorphic gloss quotation applied consistently -> classified big-sur, not skeuomorphic-quote (no literal photoreal object) and not liquid-glass (baked specular, opaque field, fails #10). HIGH icon<->brand coherence: the icon IS the brand mark, reproduced identically on the cover, matching the cover's austere black/white/silver monochrome system (bold grotesk display, pure-black ground). Background is pure #000000 (harder than the kit's softened black, but conventional for an icon field). rhymes_hint left as a hint only for synthesis to cluster.
